career_ladder.note: Administrative Officers (Scale I) in The New India Assurance Company Limited (India's premier multinational general insurance corporation) lead underwriting, claims adjudication, reinsurance operations, corporate agency management, and digital transformation. Officers advance through executive scales under General Insurance Public Sector Association (GIPSA) guidelines.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for NIACL Administrative Officers consists of a Three-Phase Process: Phase-I Preliminary Examination (Objective screening), Phase-II Main Examination (Online Objective 200 marks + Descriptive English 30 marks = 230 marks), followed by Phase-III Interview. Objective tests carry 1/4th (0.25 marks) negative marking for each wrong response.

papers.paper_name: Descriptive English Test (Letter Writing 10 marks & Essay 20 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks: 15 (13.5 for SC/ST/PwBD); evaluated only for candidates qualifying objective test

stages.source_label: NIACL — Interview Scheme & Final Merit Determination

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Online Main Examination objective score 80% weightage + Interview 20% weightage)

financial_package.pay_source_label: General Insurance (Officers) Revision of Pay Rules, Scale I Pay Scale (₹50,925 - 2,500(14) - 85,925 - 2,710(4) - 96,765)
financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹50,925/month. Total monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹85,000/month in metropolitan centers (inclusive of Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance per city classification, City Compensatory Allowance, and Transport Allowance). Deductions include NPS contribution and income tax.
official_perks: Company leased residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance across commercial cities
Comprehensive medical coverage and cashless hospitalization for officer and dependent family
Leave Travel Subsidy (LTS) / Home Town travel once in two years
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) and Group Life Insurance
Concessional insurance policies, festival advance, and brief-case grant
Reimbursement of monthly conveyance / petrol expenses and official mobile/broadband bills

competition_benchmarks.note: NIACL is the largest public sector non-life insurer in India, operating across 28 countries; its direct recruitment of Administrative Officers is the most sought-after non-life insurance officer test in the country.
